about_the_game:
Welcome to Placeground, a relaxing home builder where the way you design a space shapes the stories that unfold inside it. Build freely, decorate to your heart’s content, and watch as characters interact with your created space - playing out small moments, surprises, and stories right before your eyes.

No goals, no pressure, and no wrong choices to make. Just you, a blank room, and the joy of watching life play out in the rooms you design. Every object you place nudges the direction of your characters' stories, making every room feel like a tiny stage for everyday life.

Create, decorate, relax, and let stories unfold.

short_description: Placeground is a relaxing home builder where the way you design a place shapes the stories of the people who live there. As you build and decorate, you'll see characters react to their surroundings and experience life’s little moments in real-time.
